dialogue.htmlContent: That is not dead which can eternal lie, and with strange aeons even death may die.

You open up the pages of the book, the title [style.glowPurpleDark(PORNOMICON)] catches your eye, before you start looking through its contents.

#IF(pc.getAttributeValue(ATTRIBUTE_MAJOR_CORRUPTION) < 70)

The text is written in a shifting script, its meaning mostly elusive to you. You catch onto some words, like "offering", "birth", "gateway"... none of them comforting you in the slightest.

The deep purple ink seemingly pulsates with a rhythm disturbingly akin to a heartbeat, and you find yourself getting a growing headache as you read...

#ELSE

The text is written in a shifting script, its meaning still quite elusive to you. You catch onto some words, like "offering", "birth", "gateway"... and you find your mind wandering, whether you can be what it insinuates.

The deep purple ink seemingly pulsates with a rhythm disturbingly akin to a heartbeat, and you find yourself getting aroused as you read...

#ENDIF

#IF(pc.getAttributeValue(ATTRIBUTE_MAJOR_CORRUPTION) < 70)

You close the book, the uncomfortable whispers in your ear finally fading away. Shuddering from the experience, you quickly keep it in your inventory.

#ELSE

You reluctantly close the book, the tantalizing whispers linger in your ears, before fading away. You sigh exasperatedly, before keeping it in your inventory.

#ENDIF
